# vibeChitech

> vibeChitech is a local-first project configurator and roadmap generator for
> developers. It is a desktop app (Tauri v2) — no backend, no account, no cloud.
> Define a project (type, platforms, languages, frameworks, architecture) and it
> generates a personalised checklist covering the whole lifecycle, from
> brainstorming to deployment and maintenance.

## What it does

- 6-step wizard: project type, platforms, languages, frameworks/engines,
  architecture (databases, hosting, third-party services, architecture options)
- Generates a tailored roadmap of 16 phases (~73 detailed steps) with
  objectives, checklists, pitfalls, tips and official resources
- Conditional steps based on the chosen stack (e.g. multiplayer game →
  networking and dedicated server steps; Next.js + Stripe SaaS → Vercel and
  Stripe payment steps)
- Full catalogue embedded: 37 project types, 12 platforms, 25 languages,
  80 frameworks/tools, 11 databases, 16 hosting providers, 26 third-party
  services, 17 architecture options, and a census of AI coding tools
- Local JSON persistence via tauri-plugin-store, export/import, offline-first

## AI coding tools catalogue

The app embeds a curated census of AI coding tools across categories:
autonomous agents (Devin, Jules, OpenAI Codex, OpenHands, Factory, Sweep,
SWE-agent), IDE/editors (Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, Trae, Void, PearAI, Firebase
Studio), IDE extensions (GitHub Copilot, Cline, Roo Code, Kilo Code, Continue,
Sourcegraph Cody, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, JetBrains AI, Tabnine,
Supermaven, CodeGeeX), CLI agents (Claude Code, Aider, OpenCode, Crush, Gemini
CLI, Qwen Code), app generators (v0, Bolt.new, Lovable, Replit Agent, GitHub
Spark), code review bots (CodeRabbit, Greptile, Sourcery, Korbit), dev search
(Phind, Blackbox AI) and self-hosted options (Tabby, FauxPilot).

## Pages (per locale: /fr /en /de /zh /es)

- / : homepage — concept, how it works, project types, features
- /catalogue : full technology catalogue summary
- /fonctionnalites : detailed feature list
- /telecharger : download page — Windows .msi, macOS .dmg, Linux .AppImage/.deb
- /docs : usage guide
